name: Gym Network LiquidityMigrationV2 migrate() flaw
summary: LiquidityMigrationV2.migrate removes the caller's GYM v1 LP and re-adds the received v1 token quantity as GYMNET from the migrator's own reserve, with zero slippage bounds and no value check. The attacker flash-loaned WBNB, skewed the v1 pool, minted and migrated LP so the migrator spent its GYMNET into new LP for the attacker, then removed it and sold.
notes: The migrator is an immutable direct deployment. Its tax exemption on GYMNET (set two minutes later) only spared the migrator's transfer from the sell tax; the exploit works without it, so it changes the loss size, not the reset.

GYMNET is valued at the pre-exploit GYMNET/WBNB pair ratio: the attacker's sale moved about 15% of the pair's reserve, a slippage the market absorbed, so rule 11's market price applies rather than the lower realised 1,327 BNB. The GYM v1 left in the migrator does not offset.
